about: Java or Kotlin with Gradle. Gradle prints no test totals, so the gate goes by its exit code (no zero-test check).

requires.install: a JDK: brew install --cask temurin (macOS) · adoptium.net

verify.start: FILL IN: the command that serves the app on {app_port}, e.g. ./gradlew bootRun --args='--server.port={app_port}'
